stories.title: The Scarecrow's Award
sentences: Ravi walked into the hostel mess carrying a large bag of stale bread.
His roommate asked why he needed so much bread so early in the morning.
Ravi said he was feeding the old scarecrow that stood in the field behind the hostel.
His roommate laughed and asked if the scarecrow was actually hungry.
Ravi grinned and said the scarecrow had just won an award for being outstanding in its field.
Everyone at the table groaned and then burst out laughing at the pun.
From that day, Ravi was known as the hostel's official joke-teller.

vocabulary.example_sentence: The bread had gone stale after three days.

vocabulary.meaning: extremely good or a play on 'standing out'
a joke using words with double meanings
vocabulary.example_sentence: The comedian's speech was full of clever puns.

quiz.question_text: Why did Ravi need bread?
The scarecrow really won an award in real life.
The scarecrow won an award for being outstanding in its ______.
What does 'pun' mean?
What was Ravi known as after telling the joke?

stories.title: The Clever Student
sentences: Rahul was famous in his class for never finishing his homework on time.
One afternoon, the teacher asked him directly why he never submitted his assignments.
Rahul stood up confidently and said he believed in learning from mistakes.
He added that he simply let his friends make the mistakes first.
The whole class burst into laughter at his clever excuse.
Even the teacher could not stop smiling, though she still asked for his homework the next day.
Rahul learned that being funny did not replace being responsible.

vocabulary.meaning: a task or piece of work given to someone
vocabulary.example_sentence: She submitted her assignment before the deadline.

vocabulary.meaning: a reason given to justify a fault
vocabulary.example_sentence: His excuse for being late was not convincing.

quiz.question_text: Why did Rahul say he never did his homework?
options: He let his friends make mistakes first
quiz.correct_answer: He let his friends make mistakes first

quiz.question_text: Rahul was known for always submitting homework on time.
The teacher asked him why he never submitted his ______.
What does 'confidently' mean?
How did the class react to Rahul's answer?

stories.title: The Broken Clock
sentences: Meera noticed that the old clock in the hostel common room had stopped working.
She mentioned to her friend that the clock was right twice a day, even though it was broken.
Her friend looked puzzled and asked how a broken clock could ever be right.
Meera explained that the stopped hands still matched the correct time twice every day.
Her friend paused, thought about it, and then laughed at how true it was.
They decided to leave the broken clock as a fun reminder in the common room.
Every student who noticed it later smiled at the little joke on the wall.

vocabulary.example_sentence: She looked puzzled at the strange question.
He paused before answering the question.
She left a reminder on the fridge.

quiz.question_text: What was wrong with the clock?
A broken clock can never show the correct time.
A broken clock is right ______ a day.
What does 'puzzled' mean?
What did the students do with the clock?
options: Left it as a fun reminder
quiz.correct_answer: Left it as a fun reminder

stories.title: The Hungry Ghost
sentences: During a late-night study session, Arjun told his roommates a spooky joke.
He asked them what a ghost's favorite dessert was at midnight.
Nobody in the room could guess the answer, so they all waited eagerly.
Arjun grinned and said the answer was 'boo-berry pie'.
The room fell silent for a second before everyone groaned and laughed together.
The joke became a running gag whenever anyone felt sleepy while studying.
It turned their tiring study nights into something a little more fun.

vocabulary.meaning: frightening in a slightly fun way
vocabulary.example_sentence: The old house looked spooky at night.
The children waited eagerly for the show to start.

vocabulary.meaning: a joke, especially a running one shared by a group
vocabulary.example_sentence: It became a running gag among the friends.

quiz.question_text: What did Arjun ask his roommates?
The joke's answer was 'boo-berry pie'.
The joke became a running ______ during study nights.
What does 'eagerly' mean?
How did the joke affect their study nights?

stories.title: The Math Teacher's Joke
sentences: The math teacher walked into class and asked why the number six was afraid.
Students exchanged confused glances, unsure what the question meant.
The teacher smiled and said it was because seven ate nine.
It took a moment before the class understood the wordplay between 'ate' and 'eight'.
Once they understood, laughter spread across the entire classroom.
The teacher said a little humor made numbers easier to remember.
From then on, students looked forward to math class a little more.

vocabulary.example_sentence: They exchanged glances across the room.

vocabulary.meaning: a clever or humorous use of words
vocabulary.example_sentence: The comedian's script was full of wordplay.
Her humor made the lecture enjoyable.

quiz.question_text: Why was the number six afraid, according to the joke?
The students understood the joke immediately without any pause.
A little ______ made numbers easier to remember.
What does 'wordplay' mean?
options: a clever or humorous use of words
quiz.correct_answer: a clever or humorous use of words

quiz.question_text: How did students feel about math class afterward?
options: They looked forward to it more
quiz.correct_answer: They looked forward to it more
